from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR

    im2=ImageOps.grayscale(im2); im2=im2.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
    res,_=engine(im2)
    lines=[]

    for p in picked: print("   ", p)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Classify documents, move them, and summarize invoices.

Values were extracted from the PDF text layers (pdfminer) and from OCR of the
JPGs (RapidOCR), then cross-checked with a second OCR pass.
"""
import csv, os, shutil
from decimal import Decimal

DOCS = "/app/documents"
INV = "/app/invoices"
OTH = "/app/other"

# filename -> (total_amount including tax, vat_amount)
INVOICES = {
    "2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg": ("6558.00",  "0.00"),   # Total $6558 (not Amount due $4382)
    "JOiylq2_7S18.jpg": ("6860.45",  "623.68"),
    "KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg": ("9963.00",  "0.00"),   # Total $9963 (not Amount due $7139)
    "ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg": ("819.06",   "74.46"),
    "lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg": ("797.91",   "72.54"),
    "vvK89XK847m3.jpg": ("6204.19",  "564.02"),
    "w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg": ("44745.59", "4067.78"),
    "T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf": ("4031.00",  "0.00"),
    "UsN9tVTKskms.pdf": ("896.00",   "0.00"),
    "wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf": ("440.00",   "0.00"),
}
OTHERS = {
    "6NVuAIhTV4KB.jpg",   # curriculum vitae
    "F0oZMhSUm2dO.jpg",   # sparse scan, no invoice content
    "QOoA_j33PD_E.jpg",   # interoffice memorandum
    "WqWMArQQlSMv.jpg",   # inter-office correspondence
    "GFAlpKoFg81H.pdf",   # stock report
    "dvkRkFVFhHga.pdf",   # purchase orders
    "dx0AWchV01ZJ.pdf",   # order-details page (no invoice title/amount due)
}

def main():
    files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(DOCS) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(DOCS, f)))
    assert set(files) == set(INVOICES) | OTHERS, (set(files) ^ (set(INVOICES) | OTHERS))

    os.makedirs(INV, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(OTH, exist_ok=True)

    for f in files:
        dest = INV if f in INVOICES else OTH
        shutil.move(os.path.join(DOCS, f), os.path.join(dest, f))

    rows = []
    tot = Decimal("0.00")
    vat = Decimal("0.00")
    for f in sorted(INVOICES):
        t, v = INVOICES[f]
        rows.append([f, t, v])
        tot += Decimal(t)
        vat += Decimal(v)
    rows.append(["total", f"{tot:.2f}", f"{vat:.2f}"])

    with open(os.path.join(INV, "summary.csv"), "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(["filename", "total_amount", "vat_amount"])
        w.writerows(rows)

    print(f"moved {len(INVOICES)} invoices, {len(OTHERS)} other")
    print(f"totals: total_amount={tot:.2f} vat_amount={vat:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
